question: What final attainment follows a life of excellent enjoyments in this world?
premises: One enjoys excellent pleasures in this world
This life comes to an end
One becomes an attendant of the goddess or the god
inference: After enjoying excellent pleasures here, one becomes an attendant in the retinue of the goddess or the god.
uncertainties: devī gaṇo deva gaṇo may indicate alternative or combined attainment
plain_english: Having enjoyed excellent pleasures here, in the end one should become an attendant of the goddess or an attendant of the god.
